title: Uruguayan-Style Soy Stew
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew inspired by Indian cuisine, featuring Uruguayan soy and a hint of herbal spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the herbal spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the Uruguayan soy chunks and water, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 20-25 minutes, until the soy is tender.
Season with stew seasoning and serve hot.
